The marked points on the line are \((0,-2)\) and \((3,0)\).  
The slope is
\[
m=\frac{0-(-2)}{3-0}=\frac{2}{3}.
\]
Using point-slope form \(y-y_1=m(x-x_1)\) with the point \((3,0)\):

\[
\boxed{y-0=\frac{2}{3}(x-3)\quad\text{(equivalently }y+2=\frac{2}{3}x\text{)}}
\]
